description: Quality evaluation rubric for online health, scientific, and ingredient reference resources. Evaluates web resources across four categories totaling up to 100 points to map sources to letter grades A-E.

grade_bands.label: Tier 1 — Official government agency, clinical database, or top academic institution
Tier 2 — High-quality, peer-reviewed independent repository or medical health center
Tier 3 — Fair consumer information site; minor gaps in citations or editorial detail
Tier 4 — Weak or promotional resource with notable gaps in evidence or bias
Tier 5 — Low credibility, heavily commercial, unverified, or outdated resource

categories.label: Domain & Institutional Authority
categories.description: Evaluates the standing and credentials of the publishing entity or domain extension.

score_tiers.example: Official national health agency or international regulator (e.g., NIH, USDA, EFSA, WHO, NLM)
Major medical center, university department, or academic health portal (e.g., Linus Pauling Institute, MSKCC)
Established independent evidence aggregator or scientific publication platform (e.g., Examine.com, PubChem)
Generic health media outlet or non-specialized general information site
Commercial blog, affiliate product site, or unverified personal web domain

categories.label: Scientific Citations & Primary Sources
categories.description: Measures whether claims are backed by direct links to peer-reviewed literature, DOIs, clinical trial IDs, or official regulatory monographs.

score_tiers.example: Fully cited with direct PubMed/DOI links, explicit clinical study IDs, or systematic monographs
Provides a robust reference list or scientific bibliography, but lacks direct inline hyperlinks
Refers to general scientific consensus or studies vaguely without providing specific references
No citations, references, or primary source evidence provided

categories.label: Content Breadth & Recency
categories.description: Assesses the detail provided (definition, dosage, safety/UL, food sources) and how recently the entry was updated.

score_tiers.example: Comprehensive coverage (RDAs, safety limits, mechanism, drug interactions) updated within the last 2-3 years
Good overview covering main uses and standard dosages, updated within the last 5 years
Basic surface overview missing key safety details or updated >5 years ago
Extremely sparse summary or outdated content without clear revision dates

categories.label: Commercial Neutrality & Disclosures
categories.description: Measures independence from sales motives. Neutral, grant-funded resources earn full positive points; product promotion or undisclosed affiliate links penalize the score.

score_tiers.example: 100% independent, non-commercial mandate; zero product advertising or affiliate links
Transparent editorial guidelines with clearly separated, non-intrusive display ads
Slight commercial influence or undisclosed sponsorship context
Direct product sales, affiliate buy-links, sponsored posts, or disguised marketing content
